svg.title: PAR2 against PAR3: vs-b-equal, repair
svg.desc: PAR2 (par2-rs, par2cmdline-turbo) and PAR3 (rarpar par3, Cauchy and FFT) repair of comparison vs-b-equal on 9 machine(s). set B: 10 x 30 MiB, 1 MiB blocks, 300 + 30 blocks (10%), every arm. Recovery 30 (10.0%), damage lost-10x1m-5of10files (10 blocks). Relative speed is par2cmdline-turbo median wall time divided by each arm's median wall time; each row also lists the arm's CPU time and peak RSS. Every repair was checked against the inputs' SHA-256. Arms marked keeps .1 left a numbered backup of every file they repaired, as par2cmdline-turbo does; arms marked in place wrote none. Only arms with the same mark write the same bytes.
